O AluaSun Continental Park
The complex is located only 50 m from the Playa de Muro, close to the Albufera Nature Reserve, which together form one of the longest and most beautiful beaches on the island. The area also offers a wide range of complementary services. The beach hotel is situated roughly 4 km from the city centre of Alcudia, and Sont Sant Joan Airport of Palma de Mallorca is approximately 60 km away.
The hotel offers travellers a total of 179 rooms. A lobby and a reception are available to guests. The upper floors of the establishment can be accessed by lift. Amenities include a safe. Among the culinary options available at the accommodation are a restaurant, a café and a bar. The grounds of the hotel feature a playground and an attractive garden. Additional features at the establishment include a TV room and a playroom. Those arriving in their own vehicles can leave them in the car park of the accommodation. Additional services include a babysitting service, a childcare service and a wake-up service. Active guests can make use of the bicycle hire service to explore the surrounding area.
Each of the rooms is appointed with air conditioning and a bathroom. Most rooms feature a balcony with a view for guests' enjoyment. The rooms have a double bed or a sofabed. Separate bedrooms are also available. Extra beds can be requested. There is also a safe. The kitchenette is equipped with a microwave. A telephone and a TV add to the comfort of the holiday.
